name: Sale Context 4
definition: Sale context in which the transaction is performed.

SaleIdentification.name: Sale Identification
SaleIdentification.definition: Identification of the sale terminal (electronic cash register or point of sale terminal) or the sale system.

SaleReferenceNumber.name: Sale Reference Number
SaleReferenceNumber.definition: Identify a sale transaction assigned by the sale system.

SaleReconciliationIdentification.name: Sale Reconciliation Identification
SaleReconciliationIdentification.definition: Identifier of the reconciliation between the Sale system and the POI system.

CashierIdentification.name: Cashier Identification
CashierIdentification.definition: Identification of the cashier who carried out the transaction.

ShiftNumber.name: Shift Number
ShiftNumber.definition: Identifies the shift of the cashier.

CustomerOrderRequestFlag.name: Customer Order Request Flag
CustomerOrderRequestFlag.definition: Flag indicating that list of CustomerOrders should be returned in response.

DeliveryNoteNumber.name: Delivery Note Number
DeliveryNoteNumber.definition: Identification allocated by the sale system and given to the customer.

SponsoredMerchant.name: Sponsored Merchant
SponsoredMerchant.definition: Merchant using the payment services of a payment facilitator, acting as a card acceptor.

SplitPayment.name: Split Payment
SplitPayment.definition: True if the payment transaction is a partial payment of the sale transaction.

RemainingAmount.name: Remaining Amount
RemainingAmount.definition: Remaining amount to complete the sale transaction, if a partial payment has been completed for the sale transaction.

ForceOnlineFlag.name: Force Online Flag
ForceOnlineFlag.definition: Indicates if the Cashier requires POI forces online access to the Acquirer.

ReuseCardDataFlag.name: Reuse Card Data Flag
ReuseCardDataFlag.definition: Indicates if the card data has to be taken from a previous transaction.

SaleTokenScope.name: Sale Token Scope
SaleTokenScope.definition: Scope of the token that identifies the payment mean of the customer.

AdditionalSaleData.name: Additional Sale Data
AdditionalSaleData.definition: Additional information associated with the sale transaction.
